title: Underwriting Retention Limit: Aggregate Whole Life Insurance Face Amount per Insured Life
content:
Ashgrove aggregates Whole Life Insurance coverage per insured life. The insured life is identified by the insured's name together with the insured's date of birth.

## The limit

A new whole life policy is issued only if the face amount already in force on the insured plus the new face amount does not exceed **10000000 US dollars** (ten million dollars), the aggregate face limit per insured.

The face amount already in force on the insured is the total face amount, at the evaluation date, of the Ashgrove whole life policies on the same insured (same insured name and date of birth) whose status is applied, in force, in the grace period, paid-up, reduced paid-up or extended term. The face of extended term and of reduced paid-up coverage counts at its continued face.

**Conversions.** A policy issued by conversion of an Ashgrove term policy counts against the limit, but the term face it replaces stops counting under the term product's own rules on the same date, so a conversion never fails this limit for the face converted.

**Terminal illness accelerations.** The total of the terminal illness acceleration advances paid on one insured across all Ashgrove whole life policies, over the lifetime of those policies, may never exceed the largest acceleration on one insured set for the tier of the policy being accelerated.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Face already in force on the insured | New face applied for | Total | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| 9975000 | 25000 | 10000000 | Issued: the total does not exceed the limit |
| 9975000 | 25001 | 10000001 | Not issued: the total exceeds the limit |
| 9900000, of which 150000 is reduced paid-up coverage counted at its continued face | 100000 | 10000000 | Issued |

A lapsed, surrendered or matured policy on the same insured does not count, because its status is none of those listed.
